submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept game sky environment. Paint ONE continuous seamless 360-degree equirectangular celestial star field panorama, latitude-longitude spherical environment map, 2:1 aspect, requested4096x2048. Pure outer space backdrop, NO ground, horizon, landscape, mountains, moons, planets, architecture, characters, UI, borders, letters or icons. Attached two images are ONLY for refined Daoist Q hand-painted visual finish and restrained jade/ivory/warm-gold color taste. Main sky is very deep blue-green charcoal, lightly hand-painted, many tiny scattered warm ivory and cool pale jade stars with varied spacing, mostly pinpoints, a handful slightly brighter soft stars, no huge lens flare. Broad very faint wisps of jade-green and pale antique-gold cosmic cloud across central latitudes, sparse elegant negative space. Sky should stay dark enough behind lit planets. Projection requirements: left/right edges seamlessly continuous longitude; top/bottom polar bands nearly uniform very dark color without conspicuous points so cubemap poles won't pinch. Consistent exposure throughout, no bright white cloud masses. All texture fullbleed opaque; professionally painted game sky, not a contact sheet, not six panels, no repeating artificial grid.
